problems.note: The cosine-similarity contrast is listed only in not_extracted (S2-O7). The paper presents similarity among AI-assisted outputs versus outputs created without AI as an experiment-level homogenization comparison; p. 28 explicitly says it repeats the embedding analysis from Experiment 1. This supports across_people/diversity under extraction-spec rule 4. Multiple submissions by some participants (p. 24) leave the analysis unit and dependence unresolved; they do not establish a within-person flexibility outcome or a subgroup restriction. Retain the printed coefficient and p-value with measure embedding_similarity, higher_is more_similar, comparison_type ai_vs_bau, and AI available during production. Leave arm levels, analysis-specific counts, unit, SE and intervals null; use se_basis unclear. Keep the unspecified comparison pool and covariates as open items. The post-treatment control in the separate creativity regressions is not documented for this similarity analysis.

summary: Checked the single recorded estimate against its cited PDF page and the study design; its qualitative finding, coding and null statistics/counts are supported. Found two omitted Experiment 2 similarity variants, with coefficients and exact p-values printed on PDF p. 29. The nine human-rated creativity outcomes are correctly excluded because all reported treatment regressions include post-treatment rater AI identification. Read the entire 103217-character markdown conversion through the final figure captions, checked the relevant PDF methods/results and all regression tables, and inspected the design and result figures. Online Appendices A-F are absent from the saved manuscript; requests to the linked OSF API and project page both failed with WinError 10013, so their contents remain unverified.
